# Blueberry Scones  
A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients  
- 2 cups all-purpose flour  
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar  
- 1 tablespoon baking powder  
- 1/2 teaspoon salt  
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed  
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing  
- 1 large egg  
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract  
- 1 cup fresh blueberries  

## Instructions  
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.  
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.  
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries.  
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.  
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream.  
8. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.  

## Tips  
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.  
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

data.content:
# Blueberry Scones

A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

## Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream.
8. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

## Tips
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

data.title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | CodedCulinary
data.content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

These homemade blueberry scones are buttery, flaky, and bursting with fresh blueberries. They're easy to make and perfect with a cup of coffee or tea.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries and lemon zest.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch disc, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

data.content_preview:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

These buttery, tender blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch. Made with fresh or frozen blueberries and a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, vanilla, and lemon zest.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

Nutritional Info

Per scone: ~320 calories, 16g fat, 40g carbs, 4g protein.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
# Blueberry Scones

A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

## Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream.
8. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

## Tips
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

data.content_preview:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

These buttery, tender blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch. Made with fresh or frozen blueberries and a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, vanilla, and lemon zest.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

Nutritional Info

Per scone: ~320 calories, 16g fat, 40g carbs, 4g protein.

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones

A delightful, buttery scone recipe with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
  2. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
  3. Cut cold butter into small pieces and mix into dry ingredients until crumbly.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Combine wet and dry ingredients, fold in blueberries gently.
  6. Shape into a circle on a baking sheet, cut into wedges.
  7. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

Enjoy warm with clotted cream or jam!

data.content_preview:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

These buttery, tender blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch. Made with fresh or frozen blueberries and a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, vanilla, and lemon zest.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

Nutritional Info

Per scone: ~320 calories, 16g fat, 40g carbs, 4g protein.

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesTotal Time: 35 minutesYield: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries (or frozen, unthawed)
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and stir until just combined (do not overmix).
  7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.

  4. Gently fold in blueberries.

  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes
